errors.text_span: The tallest bars, indicating the highest CoLeG-R scores, are consistently the pink bars (“+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”)
errors.evidence: This claim is incorrect. For the LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B model groups, the purple bar ('+ SFT on D₀, D₁') is taller than the pink bar.
The pink bar for the LLaMA-2-13B model reaches approximately 80%, not 83% as stated.

errors.text_span: The shortest bars, representing “no SFT”, are the light blue bars
errors.evidence: This is incorrect for the LLaMA-2-7B model. In this group, the orange bar ('+ SFT on D₀') is the shortest at approximately 66%, while the light blue bar ('no SFT') is at approximately 67%.
The light blue bar for LLaMA-2-70B, representing 'no SFT', is at a value of approximately 81%, not 80%.
